title: Senior Data Analyst - Experimentation & A/B Testing (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Investigating 770 Million User Interactions Across a 100TB Data Lake

When a platform serves 770 million users, every optimization from reward mechanics to SDK integrations needs to be grounded in data. The Rewarded Analytics team builds the internal dashboards, alerting systems, and data pipelines that monitor the user funnel, traffic engagement, and reward consistency.

SQL and Python power deep-dive investigations and automated 100 terabyte-sized data analyses queried through Trino. Using Tableau as the main visualization tool, stakeholders have access to real-time insights on the product performance. Airflow orchestrates the pipelines that keep everything up to date. This team provides the data that turns questions into answers: every A/B experiment the product team runs, every anomaly a publisher flags, and every new SDK integration. These answers guide all the business decisions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

- Data analyst with a strong technical foundation. You have 5+ years as a Data Analyst and work fluently in both SQL and Python, writing complex queries, big data optimizations, and analysis pipelines to support product and growth initiatives.

- Master of experimentation and A/B testing. You have deep experience designing experiments, calculating sample sizes, managing variance reduction techniques, and analyzing A/B/n tests to ensure statistically sound business decisions.

- Statistically grounded. You can reason confidently about core statistical concepts-hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, power analysis, and Bayesian vs. Frequentist approaches-and apply them to real-world product decisions.

- Not a stranger to anomaly detection. You have experience working with anomaly detection algorithms and approaches like distribution analysis and cross-population comparison to monitor test guardrail metrics and identify unexpected shifts in experiment data.

- You own the systems, not just your slice. You understand the end-to-end telemetry and feature flagging systems that power experimentation. You can speak to data flows, event tracking pipelines, architecture tradeoffs, and why things were built the way they were.

- Automation-minded across the stack. You think beyond one-off test analyses and build automated experiment reporting dashboards, reusable analytical frameworks, and data visibility solutions. Experience with dbt, Airflow, or experiment platforms (e.g., Optimizely, GrowthBook) is a strong plus.

- Collaborative and business-aware. You work closely with product managers, engineers, and growth leads to translate complex statistical results into clear, actionable recommendations that drive executive decision-making.

 

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

description:
About Us

Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.

From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people - and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.

Grow a Career. Build a Future!

Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

Intern Program Overview:
We are committed to building a strong talent pipeline by investing in early career professionals. Our internship and co-op programs provide mentorship, training, hands-on experience, and growth opportunities that empower students to explore their career paths with confidence. Through competitive wages, networking events, social and volunteer activities, professional development workshops, and housing support, we strive to deliver one of the best internship experiences-designed to develop and inspire the talent of tomorrow. Summer interns work full-time (40 hours per week) from May through August. Candidates must be currently enrolled college students actively pursuing a degree to participate in the internship program.

Job Purpose

The CNH Soil and Crop Modeling (SCM) Team develops cutting-edge simulation technologies that help design and optimize agricultural equipment used around the world. Our team combines expertise in engineering, physics, and computational modeling to simulate how soil and crop materials interact with machine components, enabling faster innovation and more efficient product development.

SCM engineers utilize advanced modeling techniques, including the Discrete Element Method (DEM), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and Multi-Body Dynamics (MBD), to evaluate machine performance in virtual environments. These tools allow the team to support concept development, solve complex engineering challenges, and improve equipment designs long before physical testing begins.

As an SCM intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers on real-world projects, contributing directly to the development of virtual crop and soil models, simulation workflows, and validation activities. Interns are valued members of the team and play an active role in advancing CNH's simulation capabilities and engineering innovation

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and validate virtual soil models for agricultural machinery and field operations using Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulation software.
• Perform laboratory and field measurements of physical and mechanical soil properties, process experimental data, and incorporate findings into virtual soil and equipment simulation models.
• Expand CNH’s library of virtual soil models to support the simulation of soil-machine interactions.
• Collaborate with soil modeling, design, simulation, and test engineering teams to support the design, validation, and continuous improvement of CNH agricultural equipment.

Experience Required

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates may be pursuing an Associates, Technical, Bachelor’s, or Post-graduate degree in the following majors or a related field: Agricultural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Engineering, Biological/Biosystem/Bioresource Engineering, Agronomy

description:
AI Performance Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Performance Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $75,000-$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Performance Engineer to focus on extracting maximum throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing cost across training and inference workloads for large neural network systems. The role spans the full stack from low-level kernel optimization to distributed system tuning, requiring deep understanding of GPU architecture, model parallelism, memory management, and compiler-level optimization. The ideal candidate has demonstrated impact on production AI workloads, with strong instrumentation and measurement discipline that enables rigorous, data-driven optimization decisions. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in performance engineering, ML systems, or HPC.

• Strong proficiency in Python and C++.

• Hands-on experience optimizing deep learning workloads on modern GPUs.

• Deep understanding of distributed training and inference techniques.

• Experience with profiling tools across CPU, GPU, and distributed systems.

• Familiarity with model compression techniques and their accuracy implications.

• Strong grasp of memory hierarchies, communication primitives, and parallelism strategies.

• Excellent measurement, debugging, and analytical reasoning skills.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience optimizing LLM inference at production scale.

• Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or similar projects.

• Familiarity with custom kernel authoring in Triton or CUTLASS.

• Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.

• Publications or talks on AI systems performance.

title: SEO Specialist
description:

In this role, you’ll drive performance for our clients’ organic search presence while also contributing in sales calls, building strong client relationships, and helping refine SEO processes across the agency. SEO Strategy & Execution

Process Improvement & Professional Growth

Who You Are

• 4-6+ years of experience in SEO or digital marketing (agency experience a plus).

Nice-to-Haves

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform.

Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win-win-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams.

What You'll Be Doing

Co-Marketing Execution

• Support and execute partner co-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in-product placements, and live events.

• Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time-to-launch across partners.

• Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review.

• Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables.

Cross-Functional Program Coordination

• Provide day-to-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always-on promotions running smoothly.

• Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner-facing programs.

• Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders.

• Maintain intake and request-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently.

• Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification).

What you should have

Experience

• Experience supporting cross-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting.

Skills

• Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks.

• Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others.

title: Product Marketer
description:
About Metabase

Metabase is the leading open-source business intelligence and embedded analytics platform - trusted by tens of thousands of organizations to put data in the hands of everyone, not just analysts. From no-code dashboards to white-labeled in-app analytics powered by our React SDK, we help teams move faster by making data genuinely accessible. We're a remote-first company that cares deeply about craft, clarity, and building tools people actually love to use.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Marketer to help tell the story of what Metabase does and why it matters. You'll work at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing - translating complex capabilities into crisp, compelling narratives that resonate with data teams, developers, and business users alike. This is a high-ownership role with real creative latitude and close collaboration with product and go-to-market teams.

What You'll Do

• Own positioning and messaging for one or more product areas (e.g., embedded analytics, self-serve BI, AI features, enterprise/cloud)

• Drive product launch strategy for new features and releases, coordinating across product, engineering, design, sales, and customer success

• Build and maintain sales enablement materials - battlecards, pitch decks, one-pagers, and objection handling guides

• Conduct ongoing competitive research and maintain a sharp understanding of the BI and analytics landscape

• Partner with content and demand gen on campaigns, SEO narratives, and thought leadership that drives pipeline

• Conduct customer and prospect interviews to surface insights that sharpen positioning and inform roadmap

• Represent the customer voice internally - synthesizing insights from win/loss analysis, interviews, and community feedback to influence product and marketing strategy

• Support category-level storytelling at industry events

What We're Looking For

• Experience in product marketing in B2B SaaS; analytics, data tooling, or developer tools experience is a strong plus

• Exceptional writer - you can take a dense technical concept and make it land for a non-technical audience without losing accuracy

• Comfortable working with data: you've used tools like Metabase and can speak credibly to data workflows

• Proven track record of launching products or features end-to-end

• Strong cross-functional collaborator who thrives in a fast-moving, async-friendly environment

• Bonus: experience marketing to both technical buyers (data engineers, developers) and business buyers (ops, finance, product)

• Bonus: experience working across multiple GTM motions (product-led, sales-assisted, enterprise) and buyer personas

Compensation

The US base salary range for this role is $150K-$225K annually , plus equity and benefits.
Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

Benefits

We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment.

What it's like to work at Metabase

We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come.

title: Senior Product Manager, Partnerships
description:
About Us
We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.
Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.
About the Role
What we don't have is a product-minded presence in the market: someone in the rooms where the platforms decide what's next, who comes back with the story early enough for us to act first.
You are that presence. You source strategic signal in the field, vet it commercially, and feed it into the partner product machine - so Fundraise Up shapes ecosystem shifts like Agentforce and agentic commerce instead of finding out after they ship.
This is a market-facing product role: not business development (you don't own accounts or commercial terms), and not platform PM (you don't run the roadmap). You are the counterpart every strong partner product organization pairs with its builders.
Travel: up to 30% - covers roughly 2-3 Salesforce conferences a year, HubSpot Unbound, Stripe and Visa events, 1-2 Microsoft events, plus in-person partner and agency meetings.
What You’ll Own

•
Represent Product in the Ecosystem: Build standing relationships with product and solution leaders at Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft, Stripe - and with the principals of major fundraising agencies and consultancies; aspirationally Meta and Google.

•
Bring Back the Story: Go into the field and return with the raw material of a product story: what the partner ecosystem is about to need, who confirms it, and what it's worth - written up as a light-weight spec.

•
Bring Product Truth to the Market: Know the platform at architecture depth - what exists, what's being built, what we can and can't do - and vet every partner opportunity against that reality before anything is promised.

What You’ll Do

• Work the rooms that matter: Dreamforce, HubSpot Unbound, ecosystem summits - every event produces a written outcome memo with implications, not a trip report.

• Own the agentic-commerce watch: Stripe / Visa / PayPal / Agentforce moves, tracked early enough to act first.

• Source the agency and reseller motion: wedge plays, white-label demand, and warm-door opportunities.

• Land every signal in the shared signal intake, where the PM for Partnership Experience turns patterns into quantified bets. The bar is first-to-market timing: signal delivered before the platform ships, not after.

• Represent product live in US rooms: answer capability and architecture questions with authority.

• Complement PMM, don't duplicate it: PMM owns ICP, co-marketing, and launch motions; this role feeds them product-grounded narrative and feasibility-checked cases.

Deliberately not in this role: product roadmap and prioritization, execution through engineering/design, integrations delivery, partner account ownership, and commercial terms. Those owners exist; this role makes them faster and better-informed.
Skills and Qualifications

•
Ecosystem-native : Direct experience inside one of the Salesforce / HubSpot / Stripe partner ecosystems, adjacent partner-domain experience working with these platforms, or a demonstrable ability to build this kind of relationship network from scratch - any of the three counts.

•
Commercial fluency: Can size a market motion - ICP, mechanics, revenue logic - not just describe it.

•
Product-deep: Builds and maintains architecture-level knowledge of the platform - capabilities, integrations, multi-tenancy, what's coming - enough to hold any technical room without owning delive

title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
description: What we’re building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. <p

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. Our client is seeking two experienced Business Analysts to support a Department of Veterans Affairs program. They are seeking one Tier II Business Analyst with mid-level expertise and one Tier III Business Analyst with advanced/expert-level, SME knowledge of the Momentum financial management system.

The ideal candidates will have hands-on experience supporting Momentum within a complex federal environment and will be comfortable working across multiple functional modules and business process areas. These positions will work closely with VA customers, functional and technical teams, developers, and other stakeholders to analyze business and system issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and help drive issues through resolution.

Successful candidates will be self-directed, analytical, highly collaborative, and able to translate complex functional and technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a Momentum subject matter expert, providing functional and business analysis support across multiple Momentum modules and business process areas.

• Support the investigation, documentation, prioritization, tracking, and resolution of customer-reported issues and system defects.

• Support requirements gathering, process analysis, documentation, testing, and implementation activities.

• Develop and maintain clear and accurate functional documentation, process documentation, issue analyses, and other project deliverables.

• Communicate status, findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to customers and project stakeholders.

• Participate in customer meetings, working sessions, and other collaborative forums using Microsoft Teams, email, and other communication channels.

• Manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines while maintaining a high level of quality and responsiveness.

• Work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision while knowing when to escalate issues requiring additional technical or program-level support.

• Build effective working relationships across functional and technical teams and contribute to a collaborative, customer-focused environment.

• Support additional business analysis and Momentum-related activities as required by the program.

Required Qualifications

Tier II Business Analyst

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 5+ years of applicable professional experience.

• Mid-level hands-on experience with the Momentum financial management system.

About the Team

The Thermal Engineering team enables Anduril’s rapid hardware development cycle by ensuring advanced defense systems perform reliably in demanding real-world environments. The team works across high-power, tightly integrated products where thermal architecture, analysis, testing, and cross-functional design decisions directly affect product performance, reliability, and mission success.  

About the Role

We are looking for Thermal Engineer to work in Costa Mesa, CA, focused on the thermal design of electronic assemblies. You will own the thermal architecture of these across products spanning air vehicles (fixed wing & rotorcraft), maritime and ground systems, and wearables/body-worn devices, and you will bring an in-depth understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics to bear on hardware that must survive real operational environments.

What You'll Do

• Communicate the pros and cons of system and packaging architectures with respect to thermal considerations, and drive trade studies that balance thermal margin against size, weight, and power.

• Own the thermal FEA/CFD models and predict system performance. Define red/yellow design limits for test and operation.

• Define and execute prototype builds and tests to verify thermal designs (do CAD, select sensors and DAQ equipment, post-process data, summarize results, etc.).

• Present thermal status at formal reviews internally and with customers. Provide a clear understanding of timelines and technical status.

• Develop internal tools to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of analysis.

• Support failure reviews and root-cause analysis with test data and thermal analysis.

Required Qualifications

• MS or higher degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field with a focus on heat transfer and fluid dynamics (BS with additional experience considered)

• In-depth understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics fundamentals

• 2-4 years of experience in thermal design, analysis, or t

title: Marketing Lead
description:
✨ About the Company

Makeship empowers influencers, creators, and brands of all sizes to develop and launch limited-edition products that matter to their fans. Leveraging our design, manufacturing, and marketing expertise, we work with our partners to bring their products to life through our community-powered crowdfunding platform. Each product is given a window of 21 days to be funded by the community before we produce and ship to fans worldwide. We put our brand behind every product and guarantee quality and ethical sourcing.

We're profitable, we have a three-year revenue growth of over 200%, ranking us 97th in 2024 and 86th on The Globe and Mail’s  Canada’s Top Growing Companies of 2025  list. We are also excited to announce that Makeship has officially been  Great Place to Work-Certified™  for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at  Makeship.com .

🧑‍💻 About the Role

During this exciting phase of our growth, you’ll play a huge role in shaping our culture, our process, and the future of Makeship. Every day, you’ll collaborate, learn more about the content creation space, and watch your work impact the company and the community!

We want this to be the best work experience of your life, so we’ll pay you well, offer great benefits, invest deeply in your growth, and welcome you with our branded swag. You will also be joining one of Canada's fastest-growing start-ups!

🌟 What We Are Looking For

A marketing leader who would excel in a role that is equal parts strategy and hands-on execution. We are looking for someone who can dial all the way up to departmental strategy and then back down to how to make an individual creator’s launch stand out, then execute on the strategy.

This role requires an individual who prefers to operate with high autonomy and accountability but who also takes a high degree of pride in keeping everyone looped into their progress, updates, and work.

Preference for individuals who have managed paid agencies before and who are strong in social. Design skills and aesthetic are a plus.

🚀 Your Key Responsibilities

• Input on strategy. Be able to critique and input on existing high-level departmental plans. 

• Shape launch strategy. Come to the table with cool, exciting, unexpected activation ideas, not just campaign execution. You should be excited to go deep into an IP's lore and fandom to find the angle that makes a launch feel special.

• Work the agency relationship. Be our day-to-day partner with our paid marketing agency: brief them, keep the strategy sharp, make sure their ad creative and media plans are performing and that the ads they are putting out feel fan .

• Own design & social execution. Be able to bring campaigns to life across channels with a sharp eye for what looks and feels on-brand.

• Write (really well). Write original, fun copy that sounds fan native. You'll be hands-on with copy across social, campaign, and launch materials, and should be an excellent, above-average copywriter/editor - someone who can make on-brand feel genuine.

• Operate independently. This is a self-sufficient, self-starting role. You should be comfortable owning a project end-to-end, building processes that don’t exist and enforcing follow-through across stakeholders, flagging risks early, and contributing to high-level strategy conversations.

🧠 What You Bring

• 5-7 years of marketing generalist experience. Expertise in social media, email marketing and design. Experience managing agency partners.

• A strategic thinker who is energized by getting into the weeds.

• Genuine curiosity about fandoms, IP, and pop culture, with the instinct to translate “what fans love about this” into activation ideas that feel authentic rather than corporate.

• A sharp, funny, versatile writer and editor rolled into one.

• Scrappy and resourceful by nature.

• Highly self-sufficient, organized, and comfortable with ambiguity - this role will need to prioritize across two teams (CoLabs and Flagship) during ramp-up.

About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 38,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020-2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

As Director, Airline & Car Rental Partnerships , you will lead Engine’s strategy and execution across air and car rental supply - owning senior relationships with airlines and car rental partners and shaping how these suppliers are integrated into Engine’s platform.

This role serves as the senior external face of Engine to airline and car rental partners and is responsible for securing, growing, and evolving strategic partnerships that improve customer experience, coverage, and long-term economics. You will bring deep industry credibility, existing executive relationships, and strong judgment to help Engine scale Flights and Cars as core capabilities.

This is a senior role operating at the intersection of supply strategy, product, commercial, and pricing. You will act as the single-threaded owner for air supply initiatives, driving clear recommendations, execution, and outcomes across airline partnerships, connectivity models, and commercial alignment.

This role provides deep airline domain expertise, structured judgment, and execution leadership to inform and support those decisions as flights continue to scale as a core Engine capability.

What You’ll Do

• Lead the strategy and execution for Engine’s air and car rental supply ecosystem aligned to 2026 priorities

• Lead and deepen senior relationships with airlines and car rental partners, serving as a trusted executive counterpart

• Identify, negotiate, and activate direct supplier agreements in partnership with executive leadership

• Shape Engine’s preferred connectivity and partnership approach by carrier, rental brand, and market

• Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for supplier coverage, connectivity, and commercial alignment

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Operations to translate strategy into delivered outcomes

• Provide clear recommendations on tradeoffs across customer experience, coverage, performance, and margin

• Track and report on air supply KPIs to measure progress against strategy

• Monitor industry dynamics across airline commercial, distribution technology, regulatory, and competitive landscapes to inform Engine’s long-term positioning

What We’re Looking For

• 10+ years of experience in airline distribution, supply strategy, partnerships, or commercial roles

• Deep existing relationships with airlines (and ideally car rental brands), with demonstrated ability to engage credibly at the executive level

• Strong understanding of airline distribution models (GDS, NDC, ancillaries, fare structures) and car rental commercial constructs

• Proven track record negotiating and scaling complex supplier partnerships with meaningful commercial impact

• Strong strategic judgment with the ability to balance experience, coverage, performance, and economics

• Clear, executive-level written and verbal communication skills

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and making tradeoff-driven decisions

Nice to Have

• Experience at an airline, OTA, GDS, aggregator

title: Deputy Editor, Future Perfect
description:
Vox Media employees thrive on innovation and change while ambitiously seeking to master their subject areas, hone their craft, and improve their communities. We help smart, talented, creative professionals make a meaningful impact in media, technology, and the world around them.
Our Future Perfect section is an especially exciting place for that mission to come alive. Future Perfect covers the world through a particular prism: What are the best ways to do good in this world? Inspired and informed by effective altruism, Future Perfect strives to shine a light on neglected stories that have, or will have, a profound impact on the lives of billions of humans and animals.
Vox is looking for a deputy editor for Future Perfect. We want a self-starter who will help drive daily coverage on Future Perfect, oversee our freelance program, and edit and manage three of our writers: Sigal Samuel, Kenny Torrella and Marina Bolotnikova. This person will also assist the Future Perfect editor in overall management of the section and its staff, and will run the section in conjunction with their fellow deputy editor when the section editor is absent. This is a permanent full-time staff position.
Among our key subject areas include:

• Global poverty and public health

• The catastrophic and existential threats, both natural and technological, that humanity faces

• Animal welfare and factory farming

• The growth of progress studies and evidence-based policies that can boost sustainable growth for all

• The frontiers of artificial intelligence and biotechnology

• The philosophies and practices surrounding philanthropy and altruism, and the moral and ethical questions that underpin individual and policy choices.

Since its launch in 2018, Future Perfect has developed a loyal following for its idiosyncratic, mission-driven approach to news. Our coverage is animated by a baseline question: what’s truly important that we need to cover -- not what’s in the news, not what’s trending on Twitter, but the stories that we think truly matter for human and animal lives and the future? Then we go ahead and do those stories today.
What you'll do:

• Manage and edit three staff writers - soliciting ideas, selecting stories, editing text and managing their advancement at Vox Media . Their focuses include ethics, AI safety and policy, animal welfare and factory farming, and effective policymaking in areas like housing and science.

• Editing our biweekly newsletter on Processing Meat, written by Kenny Torrella

• Assist the Future Perfect editorial director in setting and keeping priorities, both daily and over the medium and long term projects - especially in the area of agriculture and animal welfare - and stepping in to help lead the staff as a whole when he is away

• Commission and edit occasional pieces for the Future Perfect site

What you’ll bring:

• Minimum 5 years’ experience editing, or equivalent

• Strong managerial philosophy and communication skills; previous management experience is desirable but not a requirement

• A passion for mentoring, managing and editing writers

• A demonstrated ability to bring analysis and sharp angles to news stories, as well as well as skill with handling collaborations with audio and video teams

• An understanding of the importance of careful editing, coupled with the ability to build and shepherd big ideas

• Experience in and enthusiasm for diving into research literature, particularly in economics, psychology, sociology, political science, biology/medicine, and computer science is desirable

To apply, please submit a résumé, cover letter, and 3-5 clips that you’ve edited or written (clips can either be linked in your cover letter or included as additional pages to your cover letter).

title: Bill Negotiation General Manager
description:
About Us
We are dedicated to helping uninsured and self-pay patients by negotiating medical bills on their behalf. Through a structured process of investigation, fair price determination, and negotiation, we advocate for patients by leveraging billing expertise, price transparency data, and legal advocacy pathways. Our mission is to ensure patients are treated fairly, free from unjust or inflated medical debt.
Position Overview
The General Manager reports to the Chief Operating Officer and is responsible for the strategy, performance, and evolution of our bill negotiation services , where we help patients resolve unreasonable medical bills.
We already have a Patient Advocate Manager responsible for the team, processes, and day-to-day negotiation operations. The General Manager will operate above that layer, owning where bill negotiation is going, how we improve our effectiveness, and what capabilities we need to build next.
We need someone who wakes up every day thinking about how we can become a stronger advocate for patients.
What You'll Own
Strategy & GrowthSet our strategic direction and determine how our capabilities should evolve as CrowdHealth grows. Identify opportunities to increase our effectiveness, leverage, and impact.
Negotiation StrategyDevelop stronger approaches to difficult negotiations, particularly large balances, non-responsive providers, and cases that have reached an impasse. Use results and data to determine what's working, what's not, and what we should try next.

Business PerformanceOwn bill negotiations overall performance, budget, and resource strategy. Translate operational results into strategic decisions about where we should invest, change course, or build new capabilities.
CrowdHealth IntegrationTurn what bill negotiation learns from difficult medical bills into insights that improve CrowdHealth 's broader cost-control strategy. Identify recurring provider, pricing, and billing patterns that we can address upstream.
What Success Looks Like

• Bill Negotiations has a clear strategy and roadmap for its next stage of growth.

• Difficult and stalled negotiations have stronger escalation strategies.

• You develops new legal, data, and external capabilities that increase its effectiveness.

• Your insights actively influence CrowdHealth 's broader cost-control strategy.

• Bill Negotiation scales without requiring resources to grow proportionally with membership.

• Executive leadership has clear visibility into Bill Negotiations performance, opportunities, and risks without needing to manage the business day to day.

Who We're Looking For
We're looking for a strategic operator who is comfortable building where there isn't already a playbook.
You may come from healthcare strategy, medical billing, revenue cycle, cost containment, patient advocacy, legal operations, consulting, or another complex negotiation environment.
You should be able to think several moves ahead, use data to make decisions, build relationships with attorneys and industry experts, understand business economics, and operate with significant autonomy.
Most importantly, you should be energized by the challenge at the center of Bill Negotiations:
How do we give patients more leverage when they're facing an unreasonable medical bill?

description:
This is a remote position.

Location: Remote across India; may transition to onsite in the future Experience: 10+ years in software, including 3+ as an architect or tech lead on multi-tenant SaaS, and atleast 6+ months shipping production software mainly through AI coding agents.

The role. You design the Spektra’s SaaS modular platforms and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. You own the boundaries between the .NET/Angular core and the Next.js/React/Python modules, the contracts between them, and the specs, templates and guardrails our coding agents work from. You lead by writing specs and reviewing output, not by typing code: every implementation is generated by agents and verified by you and your team.

What you'll do

•
Platform architecture

• Own the target architecture: core services (identity, tenancy, entitlements, lab engine, learner record) and independently deployed modules.

• Define module contracts: manifests, APIs, events, shared header/shell, branding, and the per-module data boundary (own schema/database, no cross-module reads).

• Make and record decisions as ADRs: edge routing (Azure Front Door), identity (B2C / Entra External ID, server-side sessions, per-module app registrations), data, and hosting.

• Plan the safe migration off legacy V1 services onto vNext, one path or feature at a time, with rollback at every step.

•
The agent-driven engineering system

• Design how work flows from idea to production with agents: spec → plan → task breakdown → agent implementation → automated checks → human review → deploy.

• Own the standing context agents load every session: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md , architecture rules, coding standards, skills, MCP servers and hooks. Review changes to them like code.

• Maintain the golden module template (our TaskBoard reference module) so a new module goes from scaffold to QA in days.

• Set the automated guardrails agents must pass: typecheck, lint, dependency-boundary rules, contract tests, row-level-security tests, secret scanning, conformance checks.

• Decide which agent, model and mode fits which task, and track cost, speed and defect rates per workflow.

•
Quality, security and operations

• Review the highest-risk agent changes yourself: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, payments/credits, infrastructure and data migrations.

• Threat-model new modules and AI features (prompt injection, credential leakage, abuse of lab environments).

• Define SLOs, observability and incident practice for the platform; make sure every environment can be rebuilt from infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/Terraform).

•
AI product architecture

• Architect AI-powered product features such as the AI Trainer (realtime voice, screen understanding, lab validation tools) and Lab Studio (AI-generated labs, guides and checks).

• Choose and integrate model providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic and others), with evaluation suites, guardrails and cost controls.

•
Leadership

• Coach developers on spec writing, agent orchestration and critical review.

• Work with product, the .NET core team and partners on roadmap and trade-offs; explain them clearly to non-engineers.

Requirements

Must have

• Deep, current experience with both halves of our stack: ASP.NET Core/C#/SQL Server and Angular on one side; TypeScript, React/Next.js and Python on the other. You can read any of it fluently and spot what an agent got wrong.

• Proven architecture of multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, RBAC/entitlements, white-labelling, API versioning.

• Strong identity and security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, Azure AD B2C or Entra, session design, OWASP Top 10, secrets management.

• Azure in production: Container Apps or AKS, App Service, Front Door or App Gateway, Key Vault, managed identities, Bicep or Terraform.

• Demonstrated daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Copilot agents or similar) to ship production systems, including multi-agent/parallel workflows.

title: Script Writer - Kannada (GyanTV)
description:
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

• Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

• Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

• Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

• Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

• Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

• Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

• Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

Qualifications & Skills

content).

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
Shield AI's Software Test & Automation Team develops the verification, validation, and automation capabilities that enable rapid delivery of Hivemind autonomy across the Expeditionary and Emerging Operations portfolio. Our mission is to provide objective evidence of software quality, reliability, and mission readiness by building scalable automated test frameworks, repeatable validation environments, and data-driven readiness assessments spanning simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) environments. 
As a Software Test & Automation Engineer (L1), you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop automated tests, improve validation tooling, analyze software performance, and support system-level verification activities for autonomous systems. You will gain hands-on experience working with autonomy software, simulation environments, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and real-world robotic platforms while contributing directly to the tools and processes used to evaluate software quality and mission readiness.

title: Senior Engineer, Full-Stack - Forge (R6244)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

About Shield AI 
Shield AI is a defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We build autonomy systems for air, maritime, space, and other platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 
Forge is the engineering platform used to build, integrate, test, and operate Hivemind capabilities. It connects autonomy developers with the applications, services, compute, data, and workflows they need to move from local development to deployed systems. 
The Role 
We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help shape the future of physical AI by building tools to develop, train, and validate autonomous systems. You will work across TypeScript and React applications, backend services, APIs, and Python data workflows, with an emphasis on extensibility and reuse. Your work will bring together internal platforms and open-source software across local and Kubernetes environments. 
You will build Forge capabilities for simulation, synthetic data generation, training, and test and evaluation, helping engineers turn ideas into proven autonomy capabilities. Working directly with Hivemind Pilot developers, Hivemind Solutions teams, and domain experts, you will translate complex workflows into reliable applications and reusable services. You will own features from user needs and design through implementation, deployment, and support. 
This role suits a generalist who wants meaningful ownership, enjoys moving between frontend and backend work, and is curious about the systems that connect them. You will help shape technical decisions and deploy and troubleshoot containerized services alongside platform engineers. Practical Kubernetes experience is a plus, particularly supporting applications in cloud or on-premises environments.

title: Senior Product Manager, Toast Delivery Services
description:
*EST OR CST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Delivery is one of the hardest parts of running a restaurant. Whether an order goes out with the restaurant's own driver or a Toast Delivery Services courier, a lot has to go right: the food has to be ready when the driver arrives, the right driver has to get the right order, and the guest needs to know where it is. When something slips, the restaurant has to make it right fast. Today much of that still depends on a manager watching a screen and making judgment calls in the middle of a rush.

Our vision is to make running delivery effortless: one place to dispatch, track and manage every delivery order. Because Toast sits at the center of the restaurant, we can see both sides of every delivery, the kitchen and the road. That lets us build smarter dispatch, catch problems before the guest notices, and use AI to take on the tedious work of exceptions and refunds.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

As a Senior PM on Delivery, you'll own that roadmap and ship it. You'll work closely with the Guest team on the consumer experience, and with POS, Order Management and Toast's AI teams. If you like technical problems that show up directly in a restaurant's dinner rush and a guest's evening, this is the role.

• Own the roadmap for your area of Toast Delivery, and decide what gets built next based on what makes delivery easier and more profitable for restaurants.

• Improve how orders get dispatched, whether to the restaurant's own drivers or Toast Delivery Services couriers, so food goes out on time and operators always know where things stand.

• Partner with the Guest team on the guest side of delivery: ordering, live tracking and quick resolution when something goes wrong.

• Take the manual work out of exceptions and refunds. Decide where AI helps and where simple rules work better, then ship it with guardrails operators can trust.

• Shape the next generation of delivery at Toast: AI-assisted dispatch, proactive alerts that catch problems before guests notice, and smarter ways to match delivery capacity to what the kitchen can handle.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• A strong self-starter: you find the most important problem, get the context you need and move. 

• A proven track record owning a product roadmap and driving measurable outcomes, not just shipping features.

• Technical fluency: you're comfortable going deep with engineers on integrations and data. You stay anchored on what it changes for the restaurant or guest.

• Strong instincts for the busy restaurant operator, someone running a dinner rush without an ops analyst, and for what makes a guest choose to order direct.

• Comfort working with external partners and integrations, where some of what shapes your product is outside your direct control.

• Experience in delivery, logistics, marketplaces or other real-time operational products is a plus.

Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

title: Account Executive, New Business
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

You’ve built a track record of winning new business. Now, bring that experience to AlphaSense as an   Account Executive , helping grow our client base across   Ireland and Europe .

You’ll sell our GenAI-powered market intelligence platform to buy-side and sell-side financial services firms, helping investment professionals uncover trusted insights and make better-informed decisions.

This role offers the opportunity to build your territory, own the full sales cycle and make a measurable contribution to our growth. We’re looking for someone who combines commercial ambition with thoughtful, consultative selling-and takes pride in earning clients’ trust.

Who You Are

•
A proven seller:   You have a strong record in SaaS or investment technology sales, ideally serving financial institutions such as investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds, brokerages, private equity or venture capital firms.

•
A consistent performer:   You regularly exceed new-business targets and can demonstrate how you turn opportunities into revenue.

•
A disciplined prospector:   You build your own pipeline and lead deals from first outreach through discovery, tailored demos, trials, negotiation and close.

•
A trusted adviser:   You engage senior decision-makers confidently, understand their priorities and connect product capabilities to meaningful business outcomes.

•
An accountable collaborator:   You take ownership, navigate complex buying processes and bring internal and external stakeholders together to move opportunities forward.

•
A curious communicator:   You ask insightful questions, simplify complex ideas and adapt your approach to each client.

What You’ll Do

•
Develop and execute a territory plan to win new financial services clients across Ireland and Europe.

•
Create opportunities through targeted prospecting and lead a consultative sales process from discovery to close.

•
Build a healthy pipeline, qualify opportunities rigorously and maintain reliable forecasts.

•
Partner with Product Specialists to deliver tailored demos and trials that demonstrate clear client value.

•
Collaborate with Marketing to strengthen AlphaSense’s presence and generate demand across your territory.

•
Bring client feedback and market insights into our product, content and go-to-market decisions.

Senior Platform Engineer - Search

About the Role

AlphaSense is seeking an experienced engineer to work on the search platform that powers market intelligence across billions of documents. You'll tackle the challenge of building distributed systems that handle hundreds of queries per second with millisecond latency, while establishing engineering excellence that ensures reliability for our enterprise customers.

This role is perfect for a seasoned engineer who loves challenges and has a track record of building robust, high-performance systems. While search experience is valuable, we believe great engineers can master new domains - what matters most is your ability to build systems that scale and don't break.

What You'll Do

• Scale Distributed Systems : Architect and optimize infrastructure handling billions of documents and hundreds of queries per second

• Lead Platform Evolution : Drive the migration from legacy systems to modern architecture, ensuring zero downtime and improved performance

• Build Engineering Excellence : Establish comprehensive monitoring, testing, and deployment practices that catch issues before customers do

• Optimize Performance : Profile and tune systems from the infrastructure to the application level, balancing cost and performance

Required:

• 5+ years building and operating distributed systems in production

• Experience with large-scale data platforms or high-throughput systems

• Expertise in distributed systems fundamentals: sharding, replication, consistency, partition tolerance

• Strong performance optimization skills - you can profile, diagnose, and fix bottlenecks across the stack

• Experience with data pipeline architecture, real-time processing, or database internals

• Excellence in building observable systems with comprehensive monitoring and alerting

Preferred:

• Experience with search platforms (Vespa, Elasticsearch, Solr) or similar large-scale data systems

• Experience with Kubernetes, CRDs, and infrastructure as code 

• Background in information retrieval, ranking systems, or recommendation engines

• Familiarity with hybrid search approaches (lexical and vector)

• Experience with JVM-based systems and tuning

• Knowledge of modern engineering practices from high-growth companies
